Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring visible clothing while recreating in a mixeduse area during hunting season.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to visible clothing requirements for individualsrecreating in a mixeduse area during hunting season; amending RCW77.15.160 and 77.08.010; adding a new section to chapter 77.15 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 77.12 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An individual recreating on public land where hunting isallowed must wear hiker orange clothing during any departmentauthorized big game hunting season applicable to the land in question. (2) A violation of this section is an infraction punishable underRCW 77.15.160.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All public land where multiple recreational uses are allowedmust be posted with signage at all public trailheads during departmentauthorized big game hunting seasons notifying users of the requirementsof section 1 of this act. p. 1 HB 1116 (2) The department shall work with other public landowners ormanagers to provide uniform signage and hunting season information asnecessary to comply with this section.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.15.160 and 2000 c 107 s 237 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person is guilty of an infraction, which shall be cited andpunished as provided under chapter 7.84 RCW, if the person: (1) Fails to immediately record a catch of fish or shellfish on acatch record card required by RCW 77.32.430, or required by rule of thecommission under this title; ((or)) (2) Fishes for personal use using barbed hooks in violation of anyrule; ((or)) (3) Fails to properly wear hiker orange clothing in violation ofsection 1 of this act; or (4) Violates any other rule of the commission or director that isdesignated by rule as an infraction.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.08.010 and 2008 c 277 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:
